body:
Maps existing Redis admission, policy, coalesced wake and runtime instrumentation roles on the metrics census dependency. Records token, expiration, generation and advisory wake boundaries without changing behavior. Durable tasks remain authoritative and the census remains partial.

Validation: component checker, 246 boundary/integration tests and 57 Redis control/wake tests passed without starting services. Two diagnostics, 24 PGN scope, nineteen earlier and ten missing-adapter fixture gaps remain unresolved. Native and live behavior were not qualified.

## Summary by Sourcery

Map Redis runtime responsibilities into the component census while preserving existing behavior and validation boundaries.

New Features:
- Add a Redis runtime census covering admission, policy, coalesced wake, and runtime instrumentation ownership boundaries.

Enhancements:
- Expand component ownership validation to require complete Redis runtime coverage and preserve its documented partial, non-runtime-proof scope.

Documentation:
- Document the Redis runtime ownership map, authoritative durable-task boundary, and remaining validation gaps.

Tests:
- Extend component census integration tests to verify Redis runtime discovery, ownership, and protection against removing all Redis owner tags.
